claim: Analysts say Costco will reach 163 million members next year.
summary: The claim is a forward-looking forecast attributed to unnamed analysts that Costco will reach 163 million members in 2027 (next year from 2026-10-28). Without tools and with a knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04, analyst projections for a future period cannot be verified from internal knowledge alone.
